_comment: Seeded maintenance tickets for Hotel Aurora (fixture data, invented). Read directly by tools/store_ext.py:load_seed_tickets(). status is always 'open' on seed; tools/triage.py owns everything after that.

tickets.detail: Guest reports the air conditioning is not cooling, blowing warm air only.
Steam escaping around the sauna door seal, needs a new seal fitted.
The bathroom sink tap will not fully shut off, drips constantly.
Bedside light switch does nothing when pressed.

tickets.summary: Guest locked passport in room safe
tickets.detail: The in-room safe battery died with the guest's passport locked inside; guest needs it back.
Wardrobe door hinge squeaks loudly - standards inspection at 14:00 today, needs to be silent.
Carpet edge is coming up in the doorway, a guest could trip on it.
Kitchen reports the walk-in cooler drifted to 8C overnight; the HACCP log flagged it.
Balcony door slider is sticking - Elena Marchetti arrives in 5 days and the room has to be ready.
Blackout blind is jammed halfway open - guest is a pilot on a day-sleeper booking and needs full blackout.
Bathroom extractor fan squeaks on start-up, not urgent.
Treadmill 2 belt slips under load, not safe to use at pace.
Minibar in the room is warm, drinks are not cold.
